ports.label: AUX
ports.about: The aux input. It joins MAIN at unity, past every fader.

ports.label: MIDI IN
ports.about: MIDI into the Sidekick, over its USB.

ports.label: MIDI OUT
ports.about: MIDI from the Sidekick, over its USB: its clock, and its knobs and FX pad as automation.

ports.label: USB-C
ports.about: USB audio: 8 channels in (four stereo taps), 4 out (two stereo returns), 48 kHz, 32-bit only.

taps.about: The main mix, after the faders: CH1 and CH2 as their faders set them, plus AUX at unity. It hears both of the tape's buses.
Input jack 1's strip, taken before its fader. It hears whatever the tape plays on bus A.
Input jack 2's strip, taken before its fader. It hears whatever the tape plays on bus B.
The aux input: digital zero until a source plays. The tape never reaches it.

returns.about: USB playback 1/2 returns into channel 1's strip, before the CH1 tap.
USB playback 3/4 returns into channel 2's strip, before the CH2 tap.
